text:
maria (PM): quick sync: proposing 'Spike Shield' reserve - small SLA-backed headroom for committed customers that auto-falls back to cheaper variants. need launch criteria + ops playbook.

alex (Eng): +1. percent vs token minutes?

maria (PM): thinking 12% of committed capacity or 20min token-bucket, whichever is smaller. flexible.

chris (Infra): note: idle dedicated nodes costly. prefer warm lanes + ShieldManager token service + soft-eviction.

lee (SRE): ops must include canary, rollback triggers. suggest p99 threshold and error delta triggers: p99 > 500ms for 5m or error-rate +1% sustained 5m -> rollback.

sam (Finance): pricing options: flat uplift (~15%) or metered consumption. prefer uplift for predictability; will model both.

anya (Legal): will draft SLA language defining "shield exhaustion" and credit caps. require opt-in for cross-region spill.

alex (Eng): impl sketch: ShieldManager maintains per-reservation tokens; routing policy reserved->shield->fallbackVariant; emit per-tenant shield_used and shield_remaining metrics.

chris (Infra): KV pin small pages while in shield; soft LRU grace to avoid warmup spike; small warm-pool per-tenant recommended.

lee (SRE): alerts: shield_utilization >80% for 30m -> notify capacity; >95% -> page and recommend customer outreach. also track failover_count and failover_latency.

maria (PM): launch checklist (MVP): spec doc, pricing rec, SLA clause, metrics dashboard + alerts, canary plan, docs for customers.

maria (PM): tentative timeline: 0-2w design & pricing, 3-6w eng (ShieldManager + routing + metrics), wk7 internal canary + chaos, wk8 pilot (<=3 customers), wk9 GA if pilot ok.

ops-bot: Ticket INFRA-5001 created: "ingest per-tenant shield metrics" assigned to eng-infra.

alex (Eng): i'll write brief spec and post to product-docs by EOD Wed.

chris (Infra): prototyping soft-eviction this week.

lee (SRE): will prepare canary checklist and chaos scenarios.

maria (PM): thanks all - keeping this thread as primary decision record. :thumbsup:
